note: Machine index of the surfacing primitives. docs/SURFACING.md is the AUTHORITATIVE carrier; this manifest is its gated index, the inverse of the routes.json arrangement where the data owns and the prose frames. Membership is held two-way by tools/test/surfacing-manifest.test.mjs (every primitive bullet's bold lead-in has a row here and every row has a bullet, matched on `lead`); the summaries are paraphrases, deliberately shorter per surface and unchecked, honest because the owner is named. Rendered by show-repo's Map view, Surfacing tab. Registered in docs/docs.json's claims table.

primitives.title: Reference is a link
primitives.use: Explicit [caption](url) for anything tappable; a proposal links its subject before the reasoning.
primitives.boundary: Bare paths drop on mobile and in copies; only a renderable page gets a render link (the honesty gate).

primitives.title: Show pixels
primitives.use: For visual changes, send an inspected headless-browser screenshot inline.
primitives.boundary: A viewport shot cannot show horizontal overflow; measure scrollWidth (SNAGS).

primitives.title: Hand over the artifact
primitives.use: Send the file the user would open or run with SendUserFile, not just a description or a path.
primitives.boundary: proactive when unprompted, normal when replying; images preview inline, other types download.

primitives.title: Lead with the live view
primitives.use: A README for something renderable opens with a prominent ⭐ link to the hosted version, before prose.

primitives.title: Toss a live view
primitives.use: Render a page with no hosted URL through the shared toss renderer rather than handing over source alone.
primitives.boundary: #gz= travels to any reader; #gh= is token- and allowlist-gated, and the token is browser-local.

primitives.title: Publish an artifact
primitives.use: Bake a page self-contained and publish it as a stable private claude.ai snapshot; auth rides Claude sign-in, no token.
primitives.boundary: CSP blocks external requests; private to the author on Pro/Max, so other readers get a 🥏 #gz= toss.

primitives.title: Stage a fileset
primitives.use: Move a fileset across repos for viewing, bundle download, copying, or review diff.
primitives.boundary: Token-gated like #gh=; an inline handoff, not a surfacing-caption row.

primitives.title: Carry content in an envelope
primitives.use: A curated, annotated set of files, chats, diffs, or hits travels and renders as one unit (stage, surface, chat-results, data view).
primitives.boundary: Prefer an envelope to an ad-hoc format; contracts and schemas in docs/envelopes/.

primitives.lead: Toss data, not just a page 📊
primitives.title: Toss data
primitives.use: Hand over a CSV, JSON array, or log through the data route, opening in the multi-mode viewer.
primitives.boundary: Same token gate as #gh=; #gz= on the page itself for a tokenless reader.

primitives.title: Branch anchor
primitives.use: The first file-modifying reply leads with Working branch: [branch-name](url).

primitives.title: Open the branch
primitives.use: Link the live branch page beside the guide PR; its facts are read from the API on every load, so the link is current whenever opened.
primitives.boundary: Token-gated with the in-app-browser caveat; 🌿 is where you read the branch, 🧭 where you merge it.

primitives.title: Guide pointer
primitives.use: Mark the branch's guide PR; close a reply with 🧭 [PR #N](url) (body synced | body not synced).
primitives.boundary: The parenthetical claims this reply rewrote the guide region, never carried forward.

primitives.title: Task marker
primitives.use: Surface a tracker task as 🎫 [title](task blob url); the filename id never shows.

primitives.title: Surfacing caption
primitives.use: End a file-modifying turn with the uniform [new]/[main]/[diff] file list, render lines after the list.
primitives.boundary: Three sizes: full (since main), turn (this turn), bare (just the 🧭 link); /caption operates it.

primitives.title: Session diff
primitives.use: Summarize substantial work with a compare link.

primitives.title: Closing state
primitives.use: Every reply that finishes work or proposes more ends with one of six labeled states (🟢 ready to continue, 🟡 decision needed, 🟠 attention, ⚪ natural stopping point, 🟣 merged, ⚫ closed), so the cheapest useful answer is one word. The first three ask something of the reader; the last three report where the work stands.
primitives.boundary: Exactly one state per reply; go authorizes only what the 🟢 list names; orange is a real problem, and there is deliberately no red. 🟣 and ⚫ describe the workstream's branch, not a task or an idea: a dropped task inside a live branch is ⚪ or prose.

primitives.title: External proxies: prohibited
primitives.use: Never htmlpreview, raw.githack, gitcdn and kin: they fetch server-side, fail on private repos, and route content through another host.
primitives.boundary: [new] for canonical source; 🥏 for a private or un-deployed render.

primitives.title: Skip the watch offer
primitives.use: Never offer to watch CI or monitor a PR.
